correctness.rationale: The evaluation-kernel map is well defined because every finitely generated subgroup of Hall's group is finite. Equal kernels give the same coordinate-marked finite quotient; inner ultrahomogeneity realizes the marked isomorphism by conjugation. Every finite-index quotient is realized by Hall universality. The abelian formula is a direct specialization, and Birkhoff's formula plus Gaussian bounds gives the stated asymptotic. The verifier independently checks the finite subgroup-count identities in nontrivial small cases.
